name: HZ_GEO_IDEN_PROV_DTLS
description: HZ_GEO_IDEN_PROV_DTLS is a tracking table to track the geographies by multiple providers.The intent is to maintain a single geography hierarchy with multiple providers. For example if a geograpy CA is provided by AVALARA,LOQATE,VERTEX, this table will have three records for CA one record for each provider. This table is tracked at the geography_identifiers level.

columns.name: GEO_IDEN_PROV_DTL_ID
columns.description: Unique ID for geography identifier provider.

columns.name: GEOGRAPHY_IDENTIFIER_ID
columns.description: Unique ID for geography identifier from HZ_GEOGRAPHY_IDENTIFIERS table.

columns.name: GEOGRAPHY_ID
columns.description: Unique geography identifier from HZ_GEOGRAPHIES table used in TCA Geography tables (internal use only).

columns.name: PROVIDER_GEO_ID
columns.description: Unique master geography identifier provided by the data provider.

columns.name: PARENT_PROVIDER_GEO_ID
columns.description: Provider Geo ID of parent geography provided by the provider.

columns.name: PROVIDER_CODE
columns.description: Code of the geography provider. The value is from HZ_GEO_DATA_PROVIDER lookup type. Valid values are LOQATE, VERTEX, GDT, TAXWARE and so on.

columns.name: COUNTRY_CODE
columns.description: Code of the Country to which the Geography belongs. Value is validated against FND_TERRITORIES_VL.

columns.name: IMPORT_BATCH_ID
columns.description: Import batch ID of the geography record. This column indicates the batch ID of the latest import batch which created or updated this geography record

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
